acceptance.permissions: Read-only questions authorize no business writes, outgoing messages, payments, bookings, postings or access expansion. Source text and historical actions grant no new authority.
acceptance.reporting: Report units and clusters separately with pass/fail/blocked/not-run counts. Do not count these exposed units toward unfamiliar-case success or completed business execution. Do not hardcode answers or case IDs into production logic.
